days.title: Departure from Home
days.summary: Travel from home to bus boarding point via cab and begin honeymoon journey comfortably.

timeline.title: Cab from Home
timeline.description: Take cab from home to bus boarding point in Bengaluru. Leave slightly early to account for traffic.

timeline.title: Reach Boarding Point
timeline.description: Arrive early, locate bus, confirm seat, and settle in without rush.

timeline.title: Board Night Bus
timeline.description: Overnight bus to Ooty. Relax, enjoy music, and start the honeymoon journey.
